in_arabic.name: طوبة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الخير و البركة و الطهارة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم طوبة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و معناه: الخير، البركة، الطهارة. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران: ﴿فَأَخرَجَ مِنَ الشَّمالِ فَأَنبَتَ مِنها طُوباً﴾. يرمز الاسم إلى الجنة و الخير الكثير.

in_urdu.name: طوبی
in_urdu.meaning: خیر و برکت اور پاکیزگی کا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: طوبی ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جس کی اصل عربی ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے: خیر، برکت، پاکیزگی۔ قرآن مجید میں آل عمران کے سورة میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے: ﴿فَأَخرَجَ مِنَ الشَّمالِ فَأَنبَتَ مِنها طُوباً﴾. یہ نام جنت اور بہت زیادہ خیر کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: तौबा
in_hindi.meaning: ख़ैर और बरकत और पवित्रता का नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: तौबा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है। इसका अर्थ है: ख़ैर, बरकत, पवित्रता। कुरआन में सुरा آل عمरण में इसका उल्लेख है: ﴿फَأَخرَجَ मिन्न श्शमाली फ़अंबत मिनहा तौबा﴾। यह नाम जन्नत और अधिक ख़ैर का प्रतीक है।

in_english.name: Touba
in_english.meaning: A name signifying goodness, blessings, and purity
in_english.long_meaning: Touba is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning goodness, blessings, and purity. It is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Imran: ﴿فَأَخرَجَ مِنَ الشَّمالِ فَأَنبَتَ مِنها طُوباً﴾. The name symbolizes paradise and abundant good. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'ṭ-w-b' which connotes the idea of returning to God or repentance, Touba holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Touba" holds a significant cultural impact within the Islamic community as it is derived from the Arabic word "al-tuş intermediate verb form of "tawba", meaning repentance, return, and remorse. Therefore, the name Touba can be seen as a fitting reminder and a beacon of hope for those who have made the journey to visit the Kaaba or for those who have returned to their faith after a period of absence or straying. This name also embodies the Islamic values of faith, pilgrimage, and loyalty to God.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Touba" carries a deep spiritual significance within Islamic culture as it denotes the concept of "return," which is intricately linked to the concept of seeking forgiveness and redemption. The Kaaba, the holiest site in Islam, is a symbol of unity and return to God. By adopting this name, one is reminded of the importance of repentance and spiritual growth. Furthermore, the name Touba also symbolizes the hope and promise of a fresh start, a new beginning. In Sufi tradition, the name Touba is also associated with the idea of the heart's return to its true nature and purpose, that is, to be a vessel of God's love and light. Thus, the name Touba serves as a powerful reminder of the spiritual journey and the importance of seeking forgiveness, growth, and ultimately, unity with the Divine.
